osool-214.title: Chicken Külbastı (Pressed Pan-Fried Spring Chickens)
osool-214.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-214-i7.name: Fried potatoes and parsley, for garnish

instructions.1: Clean the chickens and prepare them by splitting them along the back; remove the breastbone and ribs and flatten them with a cleaver.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper, onion juice and lemon juice for at least a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee in a pan until very hot and lay the chickens in it; cover with a flat lid and weigh it down, and cook until the underside browns, then turn over and brown the other side.
instructions.4: Add the water and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Lift out and place on a warm plate as they are, or cut each in two; garnish with the potatoes and parsley and drizzle with the remaining juices.
instructions.6: Pigeon külbastı: made the same way; the pigeons may also be left whole, trussed and cooked in a small pot instead of a pan.

osool-215.title: Pot-Roasted Turkey (Külbastı)
osool-215.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-215-i4.name: Two onions, a piece of celery and a piece of carrot

instructions.1: Prepare and truss the turkey and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, add the mastic and cardamom, then brown the turkey.
instructions.3: Add the chopped vegetables and a little water, cover the pot and leave over fairly low heat.
instructions.4: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the turkey and add some water, and continue until it is fully cooked.
instructions.5: Lift it out of the pot and serve hot with the fluffy rice; strain the remaining liquid in the pot and serve it hot in a sauceboat.

osool-216.title: Pigeons Stuffed with Bread and Liver
osool-216.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-216-i6.name: The pigeons' livers, cooked and chopped

instructions.1: Pluck the pigeons dry, open them along the back and remove the breastbone.
instructions.2: Mix the onion, garlic, bread, parsley and livers, knead everything well with the egg and season with salt, pepper and allspice; stuff the pigeons with it and sew them closed.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and brown the pigeons in it, then add a little water, lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.4: Lift out of the pot, place on a plate, garnish with parsley and fried potatoes and pour the remaining liquid over them.
instructions.5: Chicken with bread stuffing: made the same way using a pair of spring chickens instead of pigeons.

osool-217.title: Boned Pigeons Stuffed with Minced Meat
osool-217.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-217-i6.name: Ghee
osool-217-i6.standardAmount: 1 tablespoon (for the stuffing) and 1 tablespoon for browning

osool-217-i8.name: An onion, a piece of celery and the pigeon bones

osool-217-i10.name: Glaze or green relish (kamikh), for garnish

instructions.1: Pluck the pigeons dry, open them along the back, remove the bones and clean them well.
instructions.2: Mix the stuffing ingredients and season well; stuff the pigeons with it and sew them closed, then wrap each in paper greased with ghee on both sides and tie the paper securely.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and brown the pigeons in it, then add a little water along with the bones, the onion, the celery and salt; cover the pot and leave over low heat.
instructions.4: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the pigeons and baste them with a little water, until they are cooked.
instructions.5: Lift out of the pot, remove the paper, wrap them in fresh paper and leave until completely cold.
instructions.6: Leave them whole, perhaps brushed with glaze and garnished with green relish, or cut into slices and garnish.

osool-218.title: Pigeon and Freekeh Tagine
osool-218.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-218-i3.name: Chicken stock or the pigeon cooking broth

instructions.1: Prepare the freekeh and brown it lightly in the ghee, then add the liquid, salt and pepper and boil for 5 to 10 minutes with the pot covered.
instructions.2: Put half the freekeh in the tagine, then the pigeon, then the remaining freekeh.
instructions.3: Cover the tagine and bake in a fairly low oven until done.
instructions.4: Heat 1 teaspoon of ghee until very hot and sprinkle it over the top, then remove the lid for 5 minutes so the top browns.
instructions.5: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine and serve on a plate that suits its size.
instructions.6: Pigeon tagine with rice: made the same way using 1 small cup of rice instead of freekeh, with half the liquid milk and the other half pigeon broth.
instructions.7: Quail tagine with rice: 6 half-boiled quail, 1 small cup rice, 2 small cups quail broth and 1 tablespoon ghee, cooked like the pigeon tagine with rice.

osool-219.title: Fried Chicken with Sautéed Peas
osool-219.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-219.culturalNotes: Young birds are best for frying.

instructions.1: Drain the boiled chickens and pat them dry; fry them whole or in pieces, lift out of the ghee and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Arrange on a warm plate, garnish with the fried potatoes and sautéed vegetables, and serve with the tomato sauce in a sauceboat.
instructions.3: Fried pigeons: lift a pair of boiled pigeons out of the cooking water, pat dry and fry in very hot ghee; drain on paper and serve with fried potatoes and sautéed vegetables, or with triangles of white bread fried in ghee.

osool-220.title: Oven-Browned Turkey
osool-220.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-220-i4.name: For garnish: fluffy rice, fried vermicelli, artichokes stuffed with vegetables, stuffed tomatoes, or fried potatoes and brown sauce

instructions.1: Half-boil the turkey, then lift it out, pat dry and place it in a tray greased with ghee.
instructions.2: Cover the top with a little ghee and put the tray in the oven until it is cooked and browned on top, basting it from time to time with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.3: Place it on a large oblong plate and garnish with any of the listed accompaniments.
instructions.4: Quicker method: dry the boiled turkey thoroughly, then fry it in ghee on the stove; sprinkle the top with salt and pepper and serve garnished.

osool-221.title: Browned Duck or Goose with Roqaq
osool-221.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-221-i4.name: Roqaq (thin baked pastry sheets) and parsley, for serving

instructions.1: Brown the boiled duck in very hot ghee, then lift it out and sprinkle the top with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Place it on an oblong plate, garnish with parsley and serve with the roqaq.

osool-222.title: Breaded Chicken with Mustard
osool-222.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-222-i7.name: Fried potatoes and parsley, for garnish

instructions.1: Lift the chicken out of the cooking water before it is fully cooked, drain and pat dry.
instructions.2: Cut it into suitable pieces and remove the bones and skin.
instructions.3: Coat the pieces in the flour mixed with the mustard, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and shallow- or deep-fry in ghee, then lift onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.5: Arrange on a warm plate and garnish with the potatoes and parsley.

osool-223.title: Pigeon Cutlets with Sausage
osool-223.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Clean the pigeons, cut each in half and remove the bones except the thigh bone.
instructions.2: Season the pieces well with salt and pepper and shape them as much as possible like cutlets.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and brown the pigeon pieces on both sides, then lift them out, cover with paper and weigh them down to keep their shape; leave like this until cold.
instructions.4: Cover both sides of the pieces with sausage meat and smooth it well.
instructions.5: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.6: Arrange the pieces on a ring of mashed potatoes with the sautéed vegetables in the middle and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-224.title: Chicken in Batter
osool-224.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into fairly small, even pieces and remove the bones and skin.
instructions.2: Mix the marinade ingredients, add the chicken pieces and turn them from time to time; leave for half an hour, then lift out, pat dry and coat in a little flour.
instructions.3: Dip them in the batter, lift out carefully and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Lift out of the ghee and drain on paper, then place on a plate lined with a paper doily, garnish with parsley and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-225.title: Grilled Pigeons
osool-225.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-225.culturalNotes: Birds for grilling must be young; pigeons and very small chickens are used most often.

osool-225-i5.name: Sautéed peas, grilled tomatoes, lemon and parsley, for serving

instructions.1: Prepare the pigeons and split them along the back; remove the breastbone and ribs or leave them in.
instructions.2: Season with lemon juice, onion juice, salt and pepper and leave for half an hour.
instructions.3: Grill over charcoal like meat, leaving each bird whole or splitting it in two.
instructions.4: Arrange on the plate and garnish with the sautéed peas, grilled tomatoes, lemon and parsley.
instructions.5: Grilled spring chickens: clean 2 spring chickens, split them along the back, remove the breastbone and ribs and flatten with a cleaver; season with salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion juice for a quarter of an hour, brush with warm ghee and grill over charcoal; split each in two and garnish with parsley, lemon and fried potatoes.

osool-226.title: Roast Duck with Onion Stuffing and Apple Sauce
osool-226.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-226-i2.name: For the onion stuffing: chopped onions

osool-226-i3.name: For the onion stuffing: stale white breadcrumbs

osool-226-i6.name: For the onion stuffing: egg or milk for binding

instructions.1: For the onion stuffing: rub the onions with salt, pepper and allspice, add the thyme, ghee and breadcrumbs and mix everything well; bind with egg or milk into a fairly soft mixture.
instructions.2: Clean and prepare the duck like a chicken, then fill it with the onion stuffing.
instructions.3: Place in a tray greased with ghee and put the ghee on top of it.
instructions.4: Roast in a fairly hot oven until done (one to one and a half hours), basting with ghee from time to time.
instructions.5: Place on a plate, garnish with parsley, pour the brown sauce around it and serve with the apple sauce.
instructions.6: Roast goose: made with the same ingredients and method.

osool-227.title: Duck Stuffed with Liver and Breadcrumbs
osool-227.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-227-i7.name: Melted ghee
osool-227-i7.standardAmount: 1 tablespoon (for the stuffing) and 1 tablespoon for the tray

instructions.1: Clean the duck, wash it well and season the inside with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Chop the liver and add the seasoning, onion, breadcrumbs, parsley and melted ghee; mix everything well and bind with egg.
instructions.3: Fill the duck with the mixture and truss it, then place it in a tray and cover with the ghee.
instructions.4: Roast in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour, basting from time to time with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.5: Pour the ghee out of the tray and replace it with the brown sauce; return the duck to the oven to finish cooking at a somewhat lower heat, basting it from time to time with the brown sauce.
instructions.6: Lift out of the tray and place on a hot plate with the sauce around it.

osool-228.title: Roast Chicken with New Potatoes
osool-228.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken, season with salt and pepper and truss it; place it in a tray greased with ghee, cover with greased paper and put the ghee on top.
instructions.2: Roast in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour, then lower the heat and cook until done, opening the oven every quarter of an hour to baste it with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.3: Add the peeled small potatoes half an hour before it is done.
instructions.4: Remove the paper, place the chicken on a plate, garnish with the potatoes or parsley and serve with the brown sauce.

osool-301.title: Rabbit in White Sauce or Parsley Sauce
osool-301.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-301-i3.name: Mastic and cardamom
osool-301-i3.standardAmount: 2 small pieces of mastic and 2 cardamom pods

osool-301-i5.name: White sauce (half milk, half rabbit broth)

osool-301-i6.name: Parsley sauce (white sauce with chopped parsley)

osool-301-i7.name: Boiled diced carrots and boiled peas, for garnish

instructions.1: Put the cut rabbit in a pot without any liquid and heat gently with the lid on for 3 to 5 minutes, then lift the lid and discard the liquid released; repeat once more.
instructions.2: Add the tablespoon of ghee and sauté the pieces, then add the mastic, cardamom, enough water to cover, the onion and salt, and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Make the white sauce from the rabbit broth and milk, and make the parsley sauce.
instructions.4: Arrange the rabbit pieces neatly on a warm plate, cover with the sauce and garnish with the carrots and peas.

osool-302.title: Braised Rabbit with Vegetables in Lemon White Sauce
osool-302.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Clean the rabbit and cut it into pieces; prepare the vegetables and cut them into cubes.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, sauté the pieces and lift them out, then stir the flour in the remaining ghee without letting it brown.
instructions.3: Take the pot off the heat and add the water, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Season the sauce with salt and white pepper, add the sautéed rabbit and the vegetables, cover the pot and cook over low heat until everything is tender.
instructions.5: Add the lemon juice and season; ladle into a deep dish and serve hot.

osool-303.title: Rabbit and Vegetable Tagine
osool-303.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Clean and cut up the rabbit and prepare the vegetables.
instructions.2: Sauté the rabbit and lift it out, then brown the onion in the remaining ghee, add the flour and stir with the onion until it browns.
instructions.3: Take the pot off the heat and add the water gradually, stirring constantly, to make a brown sauce; season it.
instructions.4: Put half the vegetables in the tagine, then the sautéed rabbit, then the rest of the vegetables, and pour the brown sauce over.
instructions.5: Cover the tagine and bake in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.6: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine, fix it with a pin and serve hot.
instructions.7: Rabbit in browned flour sauce, tomato sauce or curry: cook it the same way as chicken in browned flour sauce, in tomato sauce or in curry.

osool-304.title: Fried Rabbit
osool-304.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-304-i4.name: Fried potatoes and parsley, for garnish

instructions.1: Lift the pieces out of the cooking water, pat dry and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper, garnish with parsley and the fried potatoes and serve hot.

osool-305.title: Breaded Rabbit Pieces with Mayonnaise
osool-305.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Cut the rabbit into pieces as even as possible.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, lower the heat and sauté the pieces until browned and nearly cooked.
instructions.3: Break the eggs, beat them and season with salt and pepper; add the warm ghee left from sautéing, then coat the pieces in flour.
instructions.4: Brush the pieces with the egg and ghee mixture, then coat in breadcrumbs and fry in ghee.
instructions.5: Serve on a warm plate garnished with parsley, with the mayonnaise with pickles in a sauceboat.

osool-951.title: Chicken in Aspic Mold
osool-951.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-951.culturalNotes: Savory aspic (gelatina) is seasoned stock clarified with egg white, with gelatin added so it sets clear; it is used for serving cold meats, poultry and fish. Use on average 40 to 60 g gelatin per liter of liquid, depending on the weather.

osool-951-i1.name: Medium chicken, boiled and cut into even pieces

osool-951-i3.name: For the aspic: vinegar and lemon juice

osool-951-i4.name: For the aspic: halal (beef) gelatin sheets

osool-951-i5.name: For the aspic: salt and black peppercorns

osool-951-i6.name: For the aspic: thinly pared zest of two lemons, an onion, a piece of celery, a piece of carrot and 3 cloves

osool-951-i7.name: For clarifying: whites and shells of 3 eggs

instructions.1: For the clear aspic: soak the gelatin in a little water, then put it in a clean pot with the stock, vinegar, lemon, salt, spices, vegetables and the egg whites and washed, crushed shells; whisk over low heat until nearly boiling, then leave undisturbed until the set layer of egg white floats up; keep over very low heat for 10 minutes, then strain through a cloth until clear, and let it cool without setting.
instructions.2: Take a plain oblong mold, wet it with cold water, pour in a layer of aspic and leave it to set.
instructions.3: Arrange a neat layer of peas, gherkins and carrots on top, after dipping them in a little liquid aspic, followed by a layer of aspic.
instructions.4: Dip the chicken pieces in aspic and add them, then the vegetables, and so on until the mold is full, finishing with a layer of aspic.
instructions.5: Leave the mold until set, then turn it out onto an oblong plate lined with lettuce.
instructions.6: Meat in aspic: made like the chicken using cooked veal cut into cubes, with the meat cooking broth used to make the aspic.
instructions.7: Shrimp in aspic mold: ¼–½ kg boiled peeled shrimp, 2 boiled eggs and 2 pickled gherkins sliced into rounds; made the same way in a wet oblong mold and turned out onto a plate lined with lettuce.
instructions.8: Poultry in aspic: cut up boiled birds (a pair of pigeons, a chicken, two pairs of quail, or leftover turkey or duck) with ⅛ kg carrots and pickled gherkins and ¼ kg peas, keeping back a boiled egg and a few vegetables for garnish; mix with half the aspic and put in the dish until set, then pour a layer of aspic over the top and garnish with the egg and vegetables.

osool-952.title: Chaud-Froid Chicken Breasts with Mayonnaise
osool-952.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-952-i1.name: Breasts of two cold boiled chickens

osool-952-i2.name: Savory aspic
osool-952-i2.standardAmount: ½ cup (and another ½ cup for serving)

instructions.1: Remove the skin and bone from the breasts and cut the meat neatly into suitable pieces, as even as possible.
instructions.2: Melt the aspic and let it cool without setting, then add it to the mayonnaise and stir well.
instructions.3: Arrange the chicken pieces on a wire rack or sieve with a plate underneath.
instructions.4: Spoon the sauce over the chicken pieces to coat them and leave until almost set.
instructions.5: Decorate the tops simply with thinly cut carrot and peas and leave until completely set.
instructions.6: Pour a little aspic over the decorated tops and leave until this layer sets.
instructions.7: Arrange the pieces on the Russian salad on a glass plate, surrounded by coarsely chopped aspic.
instructions.8: Chilled lamb chops in tomato sauce: season ½ kg lamb chops with salt and cook over low heat until they absorb their juices, then add water gradually until tender; lay them flat under a weight until cold, then coat with 1 cup tomato sauce set with gelatin, decorate with carrots, peas and pickled gherkins, cover with a layer of aspic and serve on a summer salad.

osool-953.title: Pigeon Tartlets in Aspic
osool-953.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Cut the pigeon meat into cubes and mix with the chopped gherkins and half the aspic.
instructions.2: Pile the meat into the pastry cases in a mound and leave until set.
instructions.3: Cover the meat with a layer of clear aspic and leave until set.
instructions.4: Place a fine sprig of parsley in the center of each tartlet.
instructions.5: Arrange the tartlets on a plate with the shredded lettuce in the middle.

osool-954.title: Eggs in Aspic
osool-954.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-954-i5.name: Lettuce salad dressed with a little French dressing

instructions.1: Wet 6 to 8 small plain molds with water, then coat the bottoms and sides with a thin layer of aspic and leave to set on ice.
instructions.2: Cut the carrots into decorative shapes; dip the carrot pieces and peas in a little cold liquid aspic and fix them on the bottom over the set layer to form a pattern; leave to set, then pour a little aspic over and leave to set.
instructions.3: Cut the boiled eggs into rounds or lengthwise quarters and arrange over the aspic layer; fill the mold with aspic and leave to set.
instructions.4: Turn the molds out onto the bed of dressed lettuce.
instructions.5: Eggs in aspic (no. 2): wet 6 dariole molds and pour in aspic ½ cm deep; leave to set, then cut pickled gherkin and fix it on top in a pattern, followed by a layer of aspic; trim a thin slice from the wide end of each egg, dip in aspic and stand it in the mold, and fill the space around it with aspic until set; turn out onto a plate and scatter shredded lettuce around.

osool-955.title: Steamed Cheese Timbales on Spinach (Vegetarian)
osool-955.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-955.culturalNotes: One of the book's vegetarian dishes, in which eggs and cheese take the place of meat.

osool-955-i6.name: Light white sauce or tomato sauce

instructions.1: Beat the eggs well and add the milk; stir the mixture, pour it over the breadcrumbs and leave for 10 minutes, then add the cheese and season.
instructions.2: Pour the mixture into small molds well greased with ghee and cover the molds with paper greased with ghee.
instructions.3: Steam the molds for half an hour.
instructions.4: Turn out onto a bed of spinach purée and serve with the chosen sauce in a sauceboat.

osool-956.title: Vegetarian Hazelnut Cutlets
osool-956.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-956-i11.name: Potato purée and tomato sauce, for serving

instructions.1: Brown the onion and hazelnuts in some of the ghee, then pass the onion, hazelnuts and bread through the mincer twice.
instructions.2: Mix everything well with the tomato juice and season the mixture.
instructions.3: Spread on a greased plate and smooth the top completely, then cut into equal pieces and shape like cutlets, inserting a piece of macaroni into the end of each.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry in the oil.
instructions.5: Arrange the cutlets on a bed of potato purée and pour the sauce around the bed.

osool-957.title: Vegetarian Baked Hazelnut Loaf
osool-957.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-957-i11.name: Brown sauce made with vegetable stock, fried potatoes and sautéed vegetables, for serving

instructions.1: Fry the onion in the ghee, add the breadcrumbs and pass through the mincer.
instructions.2: Peel and chop the tomatoes, then combine all the ingredients and bind with the egg and the stock or water.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into a greased mold coated with a layer of breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven for an hour and serve with a brown sauce made from vegetable stock, fried potatoes and sautéed vegetables.

osool-958.title: Baked Potatoes Filled with Egg and Cheese
osool-958.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes well, dry them and bake in their skins in the oven.
instructions.2: Hollow out the potatoes to remove some of the flesh and season the hollow with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Put the cream in the hollow, then the egg; season with salt and pepper and sprinkle the top with the rumi cheese.
instructions.4: Return the potatoes to the oven until the eggs are cooked; serve on a plate lined with a folded napkin, garnished with parsley, with tomato sauce if you like.

osool-959.title: Potato Croquettes Filled with Chestnuts
osool-959.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix the chestnuts, lemon zest, white sauce and seasoning and knead well.
instructions.2: Mash the boiled potatoes, knead with the butter and egg yolk and season well.
instructions.3: Form the potato into balls of equal size, make a hollow in the center of each, fill with some of the chestnut filling and seal each ball completely.
instructions.4: Coat the balls in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.5: Garnish with parsley and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-960.title: Vegetarian Scotch Eggs with Lentils
osool-960.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Cook the lentils with a little water and the piece of onion, then drain and mix with the remaining ingredients (parsley, lemon zest, butter, breadcrumbs and thyme); season well.
instructions.2: Peel the eggs and dust with a little flour, then cover with a layer of the lentil mixture, smoothing it well.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Cut each egg in half crosswise and serve hot or cold, like Scotch eggs.

osool-961.title: Steamed Chicken Mousse with Cream (for Invalids and Convalescents)
osool-961.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-961.culturalNotes: From the book's section on food for invalids and convalescents: an easily digested, lightly seasoned dish.

instructions.1: Pass the chicken twice through the fine plate of the mincer, then press through a wire sieve.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and the thick sauce, then the lightly whipped cream; season with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into a mold greased with ghee and cover with greased paper.
instructions.4: Steam for half an hour.
instructions.5: Turn out and pour the béchamel sauce around it.
instructions.6: Chicken mousse (no. 1): like the steamed fish mousse, using raw chicken instead of fish.
instructions.7: Chicken mousse (no. 3): like mousse no. 2, leaving out the cream and the béchamel sauce.

osool-962.title: Spring Chicken Broth and Chicken Tea (for the Sick)
osool-962.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-962-i1.name: Prepared spring chicken (a very small chicken)

instructions.1: Cut the chicken meat into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put it in a liter of cold water with a pinch of salt and cook over low heat until the meat falls apart completely.
instructions.3: Strain the broth and serve.
instructions.4: Chicken tea: cut the chicken meat into very thin pieces and soak in a full cup of water for a few minutes; add the salt and ¼ kg milk and put in a covered jar standing in a pot of water over low heat for 3 hours; strain, remove the fat and serve hot with toasted bread.

osool-963.title: Baked Fish Custard (for the Sick)
osool-963.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-963-i4.name: A little salt and white pepper

instructions.1: Steam the fish as for steamed fish (between two greased plates over boiling water).
instructions.2: Beat the egg lightly, add the milk and season with salt and pepper; stir and strain the mixture (custard).
instructions.3: Place the fish in a greased ovenproof dish, pour the custard over it and stand the dish in a tray of water.
instructions.4: Bake in a low oven until the custard sets.
instructions.5: Serve hot, garnished with parsley and lemon.

osool-964.title: Onion Stuffing for Poultry (and Bread Stuffing)
osool-964.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-964.culturalNotes: A stuffing the book uses with many oven-baked stuffed poultry, meat and fish dishes.

instructions.1: Rub the onions with salt, pepper and allspice.
instructions.2: Add the thyme, ghee and breadcrumbs and mix everything well.
instructions.3: Bind with egg or milk into a fairly soft mixture and use it to stuff duck, goose or meat before cooking in the oven.
instructions.4: Bread stuffing: 1 full cup stale white breadcrumbs, 1 tablespoon chopped parsley, the grated zest and juice of a lemon, 1 tablespoon ghee, ¼ teaspoon allspice, ¼ teaspoon salt and a little white pepper; mix and bind with egg or milk into a soft mixture, and use to stuff poultry, fish and meat.

ec-003.title: Cold Black-Eyed Bean Salad (Lubya Nashfa Barda)
ec-003.culturalNotes: Recipe 3, page 6 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Leave the beans to soak in plenty of water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain them, cover with fresh water and boil for about 30 minutes, until tender.
instructions.3: Drain again and spread the beans out on a tray so they cool quickly without turning mushy.
instructions.4: Pound the garlic with a little salt, then stir in the lemon juice, oil and pepper.
instructions.5: Pour the garlic dressing over the cool beans and fold it through gently so every bean is coated.
instructions.6: Onion and mint version (recipe 339 in the book): boil one onion with the beans, adding the salt for the last 5 minutes. Once cool, toss the beans with a second, finely chopped onion, a few fresh mint leaves and a simple dressing of oil, lemon juice, a little vinegar, salt and pepper.

ec-005.title: Fried Kubeiba Discs (Kubeiba A'ras)
ec-005.culturalNotes: Recipe 5, page 7 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the bulgur in cold water until it swells, then drain and squeeze it dry in a cloth.
instructions.2: Mince the beef finely, then mix the minced meat with the squeezed bulgur, grated onion, salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Knead the mixture with hands in a bowl full of icy water, folding it over and over until it is very light and feels like a mousse.
instructions.4: Form the mixture into patties with well-oiled hands, pressing them flat and even.
instructions.5: Fry the discs in deep hot fat until brown on both sides.
instructions.6: Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot.

ec-007.title: Houmous (Hummus)
ec-007.culturalNotes: Recipe 7, page 8 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Blend or pound the hot chickpeas to a paste.
instructions.2: Pound the garlic with salt, then add the tahini and blend into the chickpeas.
instructions.3: Add the lemon juice slowly, beating hard to incorporate it.
instructions.4: Spread the hummus on a shallow dish.
instructions.5: Option: pour a little hot olive oil over it and sprinkle with paprika and parsley.

ec-008.title: Mashed Broad Beans, Warm and Cold (Foul Medames)
ec-008.culturalNotes: Recipe 8, page 8 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-008-i1.name: Dried Broad Beans Or Split Fava Beans (foul)

instructions.1: Soak the beans overnight in plenty of water.
instructions.2: Drain the beans, cover with fresh water and simmer very gently for 3–4 hours, until the beans fall apart easily.
instructions.3: Fry the sliced garlic in the oil until pale gold, add salt and pepper and pour over the beans.
instructions.4: Squeeze the lemon juice over the top and stir.
instructions.5: Serve warm with hard-boiled egg halves on top.

ec-010.title: Spinach and Walnut Dip (Mahammara)
ec-010.culturalNotes: Recipe 10, page 9 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Blanch the spinach briefly in boiling water, then drain and squeeze it very dry.
instructions.2: Mix the chopped spinach with the ground walnuts and crushed garlic.
instructions.3: Add the pomegranate molasses or tamarind water, oil, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Mix well and serve at room temperature.

ec-012.title: Cheese and Yogurt Dip (Labneh Maakhal)
ec-012.culturalNotes: Recipe 12, page 10 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Mix the labneh with the crushed garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Spoon into a shallow dish and make a well in the centre.
instructions.3: Pour a little olive oil into the well.
